title: Monsoon and Current
author: Ulyana Fairweather
blurb: Jude Vasquez, a storm chaser who owes money to dangerous optimists, keeps moving because stopping costs more. Then the tide reveals a cave that legends charge admission to — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must cross the range ahead of the snows, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
